title: The Year in Twelve Moments
short_teaser: Looking back through one meaningful moment from each month can reveal a year more accurately than judging it by the loudest event.
story: Looking back through one meaningful moment from each month can reveal a year more accurately than judging it by the loudest event. A broader timeline prevents one difficult period from defining everything. Reflection turns experience into guidance. The goal is not to stay in the past, but to carry forward what the past can teach. The lasting value is not merely knowing the fact. It is seeing the pattern beneath it and considering where that same pattern may already be present in ordinary life, creative work, or business.
impact: A broader timeline prevents one difficult period from defining everything. Reflection turns experience into guidance. The goal is not to stay in the past, but to carry forward what the past can teach.
spark_application: Write one sentence about what this story brings up for you, one lesson worth keeping, and one thing you may do differently. Save a short note about what you noticed, what surprised you, or what you may want to revisit.
